_comment: Spend caps for every Bellwether command that costs money. Checked before a run,
not after. Edit the numbers here; no command hardcodes its own limit.
Measured 2026-09-23 with scripts/api_check.py:
SerpAPI    Free plan, 250 searches/month, 213 left, 37 already used.
SHARED with the SERP Tracker's daily client rank checks, which
cost 5 searches per query per run. That is the tight one.
Hunter     Free plan, 50 searches + 100 verifications/month, resets the 20th.
DataForSEO pay-as-you-go, $0.54 left. Needs a top-up before traffic estimates.
YouTube    free, 10,000 units/day. A scout search costs 100, a donor scan ~4/channel.
How each cap is enforced, in this order:
1. reserve        — never spend below this many searches left on the account,
so the tracker's client rank checks keep running.
2. monthly_cap    — Bellwether's own share per calendar month, counted from
data/api-usage.csv.
3. confirm_above  — a bigger run exits with code 3 and prints the plan instead
of spending. Re-run with --yes once Nicole approves.
2026-10-06, Nicole (CHANGELOG D11): reserve 80 -> 50, monthly cap 100 -> 160, to run
the 61 plural brand-review queries. The tracker's use turned out to be manual, not
daily: 213 searches left on Oct 2 and still 213 on the morning of Oct 6. The 80 was
sized for daily rank checks that are not happening. Revisit if they start.

hunter._cycle: Counted from the 20th, Hunter's own reset day, not the calendar month (D20, Nicole 2026-10-22).
